measurement: file open through first PCM group and through complete decode with full sample checksum; warm filesystem cache, process startup and close excluded
output_storage: reusable signed 32-bit PCM in both implementations; raw IEEE float bits
native_peak_rss: whole Linux process VmHWM after reading the file
fresh_bytes: New Fern runtime heap storage. The separate C profile counts successful external glibc malloc, calloc and realloc calls within the measured decode scope.
limitations: one host; no physical Android latency, power or thermal measurements
